rows_data = cells('Allowed assignments', 'L812:N820')
from itertools import permutations
tasks = list(set(r[0] for r in rows_data))
workers = list(set(r[1] for r in rows_data))
cost_map = {(r[0], r[1]): r[2] for r in rows_data}
max_cov = 0
for p in permutations(workers, len(tasks)):
    cov = sum(1 for t, w in zip(tasks, p) if (t, w) in cost_map)
    if cov > max_cov:
        max_cov = cov
result = max_cov
